my_error: PLAN_K711.md sec 5 says depth caps give exact counts and a time-capped abort gives none, and I then ran a depth-capped job WITH a time cap. A depth cap only yields exact counts if the run completes; adding a time cap reintroduces precisely the invalidity the depth cap was chosen to avoid.
